brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, as the unit cannot be attended before the event due to the conservator level low, cooling stage cycling intermittently, and outstanding defect notice from the last inspection round is still current. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified. [MG-023, MG-021]
